description: Sync ALL tenants: push Builder FS → GitHub, then pull GitHub → Core MongoDB. Requires master key authentication. Returns a summary table with results for each tenant/solution.

pull_only.description: Only pull from GitHub to Core (skip push). Default: false (full sync).

push_only.description: Only push to GitHub (skip pull to Core). Default: false (full sync).

name: ateam_sync_all
